# AstryxFieldStatus { #anylumino.AstryxFieldStatus }

```python
AstryxFieldStatus(message, *, type='success', variant='detached', **props)
```

Render an Astryx field status message.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Default      |
|---------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| message | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | _required_   |
| type    | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `'success'`  |
| variant | str    | Astryx visual variant.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `'detached'` |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe FieldStatus props. Useful keys: id, className, and style. The type prop supports error, warning, and success; variant supports attached and detached. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/FieldStatus>. | `{}`         |
